onboarding.demo.apple_new_owner: Apple: new owner, no business yet
onboarding.launch.title: A smoother day starts here
onboarding.launch.body: Jobs, WhatsApp updates and signed documents move together from check-in to hand-over.
onboarding.intro.jobs_title: Jobs and customers in one place
onboarding.intro.jobs_body: Check cars in, follow every job on the board and keep each customer's vehicles and history at hand.
onboarding.intro.docs_body: Send quotes, get contracts signed on the spot and keep customers informed over WhatsApp.
onboarding.intro.team_body: Add staff, sign in on the web by scanning a QR code and ask the assistant when you need a hand.
onboarding.org.none_description: Create your business to get started. It only takes a minute.
onboarding.org.invited: Were you invited? Ask your manager to add {{email}} to the business.
onboarding.org.invited_closed: Ask your manager to add {{email}} to the business, then sign in again.
onboarding.create.title: Create business
onboarding.create.name_length: Business name must be 2 to 120 characters
onboarding.create.error_conflict: You already own a business. Opening it now.
onboarding.create.error_conflict_missing: You already own a business. Sign out and in again to open it.
onboarding.create.error_disabled: Creating a business in the app is turned off right now. Ask your manager to add you to their business.
onboarding.create.error_rate: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
onboarding.create.error_network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
onboarding.create.error_generic: Your business could not be created. Try again.
onboarding.create.error_enter: Your business was created but couldn't be opened. Pick it from the list.
onboarding.create.services_partial: Some services couldn't be added. You can add them later under Catalog → Services.
onboarding.first_run.services_body: Check the prices so jobs are quick to open.
onboarding.first_run.staff_body: Give your team their own sign-in.
onboarding.first_run.jobs_body: Check a car in and follow it on the board.
onboarding.first_run.qr_title: Sign in on the web by QR
onboarding.first_run.qr_body: Scan the code on the web sign-in page, no password needed.
onboarding.first_run.assistant_body: Get today's jobs or a quick summary in plain words.
onboarding.diagnostics.reset_done: Onboarding flags reset. The intro shows after sign-out, the first-run sheet on the next visit to Home.
